method: Closed-form ideal inert surfaces. Height, lateral distance and scan parameters in µm. Tolerances account for floating-point error and the declared optical envelope sampler, not actual hardware uncertainty.

fixtures.configuration: 64 × 48 opaque plane, dz/dx = +0.001, dz/dy = −0.0005. Center dropout block 9 × 7. 5×, ±15 µm, z0=0, noise off.
Height difference 5 µm, same tilt on both terraces. 9 × 7 prescribed dropout. ±15 µm, noise off. Exclude two seam columns from shared-plane and step estimates only.
64 horizontal samples, centered cosine with 8 periods of amplitude 0.2 µm, no tilt, no dropout, noise off. Equal phase samples centered on pixel centers.
Centered inert 6 µm step, plane untilted, scan center 0, ±2 µm half-span, no dropout, noise off.
Remove coupon while stage is at load position; request measurement.
